items.question: How was Pointers born?
items.answer: Pointers was born with a clear intention: to unite creativity with strategy. We wanted to build brands that not only look good, but work with direction, coherence and real results.

items.question: What kind of brands work with Pointers?
items.answer: We collaborate with brands looking to grow with purpose — from startups with a solid vision to established companies updating their digital presence without losing their essence.

items.question: What makes Pointers different from other digital agencies?
items.answer: Instead of separating branding, web and marketing, we integrate them into one flow. This lets us build coherent digital ecosystems where every decision has purpose and every delivery measurable impact.

items.question: What's the philosophy behind each project?
items.answer: We believe excellence isn't about doing more, but doing better. Every project reflects attention to detail, strategic clarity and commitment to results that last.

items.question: How do you stay up to date with new digital trends?
items.answer: Continuous learning is part of our culture. We combine research, data analysis and constant exploration in design, UX and automation to stay one step ahead.

items.question: What are Pointers' main services?
items.answer: Branding & Visual Identity, Web Design & Digital Experience, Content & Social Presence, and Digital Strategy & Advertising. We combine strategy, design and technology to build solutions that truly work.

items.question: What if I don't have a defined brand yet?
items.answer: In the Discovery phase we analyze your business, competitors and opportunities to define a solid starting point. Then, in Strategy & Concept, we outline the plan and project identity.

problem.body: Your brand looks inconsistent and fails to build trust. Improvised logos, mixed colors and scattered messaging make you compete without real differentiation.

faq.question: How long does a branding project take?
faq.answer: Between 3 and 6 weeks depending on the plan. Pro covers essential identity; Pointers includes full brand architecture with workshop.

faq.question: Do you include revisions?
faq.answer: Yes. Pro includes 1 round, Premium 3 rounds and Pointers unlimited revisions during the design phase.

faq.question: Do you deliver editable files?
faq.answer: Yes. You receive vector logos, brand guidelines and assets ready for web and print.

faq.question: Can you work with an existing brand?
faq.answer: Absolutely. We can evolve your current identity or build a new one from scratch based on your business stage.

faq.question: Do you build on WordPress or other platforms?
faq.answer: We work with Next.js and modern stacks for maximum performance. The Pointers plan includes a CMS for self-management.

faq.question: Is hosting and domain included?
faq.answer: Not included in the base price, but we guide you through setup and deployment on Vercel or another platform.

faq.question: Can you redesign my current site?
faq.answer: Yes. We audit your existing site and propose UX, design and performance improvements based on the chosen plan.

faq.question: How long does a web project take?
faq.answer: 4 to 8 weeks depending on scope: landing in Pro, full site in Premium and custom experience in Pointers.
